svg.title: One language, every terminal — 9 terminal profiles
svg.desc: State stays legible across color depths, measured grounds and plain text. Actual status-mark buffers: dark-truecolor, dark-graphite, light-truecolor, dark-256, light-256, ansi-16, unknown-ground, no-color, ascii
